description: Author-created prospective holdout authored after runtime freeze; never used for post-freeze tuning. Not an independent external blind study.

questions.question: Give just the number of distinct security IDs held by Total Stock Market Index Fund.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.security_id) FROM holdings h JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Total Stock Market Index Fund'

questions.question: Across Stock holdings, what is the smallest recorded cost_basis? Return one number rounded to two decimals.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT ROUND(MIN(h.cost_basis),2) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.asset_type='Stock'

questions.question: How many Bond securities have current_price strictly below 100? Return only the count.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securities WHERE asset_type='Bond' AND current_price<100

questions.question: List only the security symbols in the Consumer Discretionary sector, sorted in reverse alphabetical order.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.symbol FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec USING(sector_id) WHERE sec.sector_name='Consumer Discretionary' ORDER BY s.symbol DESC

questions.question: List portfolio_name for portfolios with status Active created before 2020-01-01, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE status='Active' AND creation_date<'2020-01-01' ORDER BY portfolio_name

questions.question: For Stock positions in Tech Innovation Fund, show symbol and quantity, in that field order, ordered by symbol ascending.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT s.symbol,h.quantity FROM holdings h JOIN securities s USING(security_id) JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='Tech Innovation Fund' AND s.asset_type='Stock' ORDER BY s.symbol

questions.question: Sum recorded transaction fees for ESG Sustainable Fund. Return one value rounded to two decimals, using zero if there are no transactions.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t.fees),0),2) FROM transactions t JOIN portfolios p USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.portfolio_name='ESG Sustainable Fund'

questions.question: Which portfolios hold at least two Bond positions? Return portfolio_name and number of Bond holdings, alphabetically by portfolio_name.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,COUNT(*) FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.asset_type='Bond' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id,p.portfolio_name HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: For every sector, including one with no securities, return sector_name and count of distinct security IDs assigned to it. Sort sector_name ascending.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT sec.sector_name,COUNT(DISTINCT s.security_id) FROM sectors sec LEFT JOIN securities s USING(sector_id) GROUP BY sec.sector_id,sec.sector_name ORDER BY sec.sector_name

questions.question: Show portfolio_name and creation_date for the three most recently created portfolios. Sort newest first, breaking equal-date ties by portfolio_name ascending.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name,creation_date FROM portfolios ORDER BY creation_date DESC,portfolio_name ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Show the two latest recorded price_date and close_price observations for symbol CORP-A-10Y, date descending. Use those two output fields only.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT hp.price_date,hp.close_price FROM historical_prices hp JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.symbol='CORP-A-10Y' ORDER BY hp.price_date DESC LIMIT 2

questions.question: For each portfolio whose status is Passive, return portfolio_name and total listed holding quantity, including Bonds and using zero if empty. Sort portfolio_name ascending.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,COALESCE(SUM(h.quantity),0) FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) WHERE p.status='Passive' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id,p.portfolio_name ORDER BY p.portfolio_name
